say:26:1610316020:1.source_cn: 但愿我们都能拿出真正的实力，我很期待能与你较量。
say:26:1610316020:1.male: I hope we can both show our true strength to everyone. I'm looking forward to competing with you.
say:26:1610316020:1.female: I hope we can both show our true strength to everyone. I'm looking forward to competing with you.

say:27:1610316021:1.text: Hey, look at you getting serious. You've got me a bit fired up as well.
say:27:1610316021:1.source_cn: 你这家伙，认真起来了啊。好……我也得拿出干劲才行。

say:28:1610316022:1.text: But I'm a little worried about Pippa. I need to go find her.
say:28:1610316022:1.source_cn: 不过，我现在有点担心皮帕，我想去找她。

say:29:1610316023:1.text: Members of the royal court will be attending. I'm afraid she'll cause a mess at a critical moment.
say:29:1610316023:1.source_cn: 这次选拔赛会有王室成员到场，我怕她在这个节骨眼弄出乱子。

say:30:1610316024:1.text: You do have a point. Pippa's magic does tend to get out of control... Let's go find her together.
say:30:1610316024:1.source_cn: 你说得有道理，皮帕的魔法确实容易失控，但也很强……我们...

say:31:1610316025:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, although we've only just met, I wish you good luck in this selection.
say:31:1610316025:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, although we've only just met, I wish you good luck in this selection.
say:31:1610316025:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, although we've only just met, I wish you good luck in this selection.

say:33:1610316016:1.text: You just made that up, didn't you?
say:33:1610316016:1.male: You just made that up, didn't you?
say:33:1610316016:1.female: You just made that up, didn't you?

say:34:1610316017:2.text: He must have his reasons for keeping it to himself. You don't have to push, Silven.
say:34:1610316017:2.source_cn: 或许是有不想告诉我们的理由吧，休，不必勉强。
say:34:1610316017:2.male: He must have his reasons for keeping it to himself. You don't have to push, Silven.
say:34:1610316017:2.female: She must have her reasons for keeping it to herself. You don't have to push, Silven.

choice:21:1:2.text: I'm in debt to a scary innkeeper.
choice:21:1:2.male: I'm in debt to a scary innkeeper.
choice:21:1:2.female: I'm in debt to a scary innkeeper.

say:35:1610316013:1.text: Good, thank you for treating me normally.
say:35:1610316013:1.source_cn: 是啊，我们并无不同。感谢你的尊重。
say:35:1610316013:1.male: Good, thank you for treating me normally.
say:35:1610316013:1.female: Good, thank you for treating me normally.

choice:12:0:1.text: Do you mind if I ask you what happened?
choice:12:0:1.male: Do you mind if I ask you what happened?
choice:12:0:1.female: Do you mind if I ask you what happened?

say:0:1610317001:0.text: Wow, that was loud! It came from Pippa's direction.
say:0:1610317001:0.source_cn: 好大的声响！是皮帕那边传来的。
say:0:1610317001:0.male: Wow, that was loud! It came from Pippa's direction.
say:0:1610317001:0.female: Wow, that was loud! It came from Pippa's direction.

say:1:1610318001:1.text: Take it easy, Pippa. It was just a small explosion. See? I've already put out the fire.
say:1:1610318001:1.source_cn: 皮帕……冷静点，小爆炸而已，没关系。看，我已经把火灭掉了。

choice_prompt:2:1610318001.text: Take it easy, Pippa. It was just a small explosion. See? I've already put out the fire.
choice_prompt:2:1610318001.source_cn: 皮帕……冷静点，小爆炸而已，没关系。看，我已经把火灭掉了。

say:3:1610318002:1.text: Well, we've experienced this a few times. Compared to the time she almost blew up the greenhouse, this is nothing.
say:3:1610318002:1.source_cn: 是啊……见多了。她之前差点把温室点燃，和那次相比，这都...
say:3:1610318002:1.male: Well, we've experienced this a few times. Compared to the time she almost blew up the greenhouse, this is nothing.
say:3:1610318002:1.female: Well, we've experienced this a few times. Compared to the time she almost blew up the greenhouse, this is nothing.

say:4:1610318004:1.text: My magic is innate but very hard to control. When I cast spells, the magical power gets away from me sometimes...
say:4:1610318004:1.source_cn: 我的魔力很难控制，这是天生的……我施法的时候，魔法能量...
say:4:1610318004:1.male: My magic is innate but very hard to control. When I cast spells, the magical power gets away from me sometimes...
say:4:1610318004:1.female: My magic is innate but very hard to control. When I cast spells, the magical power gets away from me sometimes...

say:5:1610318005:1.text: My old professor at the Astral Academy said this kind of thing is difficult to change...
say:5:1610318005:1.source_cn: 以前在星界学院的老师说过，这种事很难改变……
say:5:1610318005:1.male: My old professor at the Astral Academy said this kind of thing is difficult to change...
say:5:1610318005:1.female: My old professor at the Astral Academy said this kind of thing is difficult to change...

choice_prompt:6:1610318005.text: My old professor at the Astral Academy said this kind of thing is difficult to change...
choice_prompt:6:1610318005.source_cn: 以前在星界学院的老师说过，这种事很难改变……
choice_prompt:6:1610318005.male: My old professor at the Astral Academy said this kind of thing is difficult to change...
choice_prompt:6:1610318005.female: My old professor at the Astral Academy said this kind of thing is difficult to change...

say:7:1610318006:0.text: I didn't leave. I was expelled. My magic was always causing problems there...
say:7:1610318006:0.source_cn: 因为我的魔法总是会引发混乱，我被那里开除了……
say:7:1610318006:0.male: I didn't leave. I was expelled. My magic was always causing problems there...
say:7:1610318006:0.female: I didn't leave. I was expelled. My magic was always causing problems there...

say:8:1610318007:0.text: Thanks to Professor Solise, I was accepted into the Serene Lyceum.
say:8:1610318007:0.source_cn: 多亏娑丽丝老师帮我说好话，还有莱希拉姆愿意接纳我。
say:8:1610318007:0.male: Thanks to Professor Solise, I was accepted into the Serene Lyceum.
say:8:1610318007:0.female: Thanks to Professor Solise, I was accepted into the Serene Lyceum.

say:9:1610318010:0.text: B-but I'm scared... scared of being expelled from school again...
say:9:1610318010:0.source_cn: 可是、可是我很害怕，害怕又一次被学校开除……
say:9:1610318010:0.male: B-but I'm scared... scared of being expelled from school again...
say:9:1610318010:0.female: B-but I'm scared... scared of being expelled from school again...

say:10:1610318011:0.text: I've already blown up three classrooms, two dormitories, and one cafeteria in the past few days! I just blew up my boat a few minutes ago.
say:10:1610318011:0.source_cn: 这几天我已经炸坏了三次教室两次宿舍和一次食堂！刚才我还...
say:10:1610318011:0.male: I've already blown up three classrooms, two dormitories, and one cafeteria in the past few days! I just blew up my boat a few minutes ago.
say:10:1610318011:0.female: I've already blown up three classrooms, two dormitories, and one cafeteria in the past few days! I just blew up my boat a few minutes ago.

choice_prompt:11:1610318011.text: I've already blown up three classrooms, two dormitories, and one cafeteria in the past few days! I just blew up my boat a few minutes ago.
choice_prompt:11:1610318011.source_cn: 这几天我已经炸坏了三次教室两次宿舍和一次食堂！刚才我还把船弄没了！
choice_prompt:11:1610318011.male: I've already blown up three classrooms, two dormitories, and one cafeteria in the past few days! I just blew up my boat a few minutes ago.
choice_prompt:11:1610318011.female: I've already blown up three classrooms, two dormitories, and one cafeteria in the past few days! I just blew up my boat a few minutes ago.

say:12:1610318012:1.text: Why did you think I was in water?
say:12:1610318012:1.source_cn: 嗯……否则我为什么会掉进水里呢？
say:12:1610318012:1.male: Why did you think I was in water?
say:12:1610318012:1.female: Why did you think I was in water?

say:13:1610318013:1.text: Hey, don't worry. The Lyceum has more than enough funds for repairs. A small accident like this is no reason to expel you. Plus, the cafeteria incident improved the food, so you're kind of a hero.
say:13:1610318013:1.source_cn: 别担心，莱希拉姆有的是钱修缮公共设施，才不会因为这些小...
say:13:1610318013:1.male: Hey, don't worry. The Lyceum has more than enough funds for repairs. A small accident like this is no reason to expel you. Plus, the cafeteria incident improved the food, so you're kind of a hero.
say:13:1610318013:1.female: Hey, don't worry. The Lyceum has more than enough funds for repairs. A small accident like this is no reason to expel you. Plus, the cafeteria incident improved the food, so you're kind of a hero.

say:14:1610318014:1.text: But I didn't realize you wanted to become a court mage. Everything in the royal court costs a fortune. If you blew something up there, I doubt a lifetime of earnings could cover the damage.
say:14:1610318014:1.source_cn: 不过，我没想到你也想成为宫廷魔法师。王宫里的东西全都价...

say:16:1610318015:1.text: No, no, no! I didn't want to! I never intended to participate!
say:16:1610318015:1.source_cn: 不不不！我不想！我根本没打算参加这次选拔。

say:17:1610318016:1.text: I had a package I wanted to mail home, so I asked for a mailing slip. Later, I discovered it wasn't a mailing slip... It was a registration form for the selection!
say:17:1610318016:1.source_cn: 我有一包东西想寄回家，去要了一张邮寄单，后来我才发现，...

say:18:1610318017:1.text: Well, if it was a mistake, you don't have to participate.
say:18:1610318017:1.source_cn: 呃……所以你搞错了？那完全可以不参加嘛。

say:19:1610318018:1.text: Yes, but Professor Solise thought I wanted to participate... She seemed so happy. I didn't want to disappoint her...
say:19:1610318018:1.source_cn: 可是，娑丽丝老师以为我想参加……她很高兴的样子，我不想...

say:20:1610318019:1.text: So, what now? Just stand here and wait?
say:20:1610318019:1.source_cn: 话说，接下来我们到底该做什么呢？光是站在这里等着吗？

say:21:1610318020:1.text: It's a bit strange that the headmaster left after he finished his speech.
say:21:1610318020:1.source_cn: 是有些奇怪，校长说完话就走了。

say:22:1610318021:1.text: Also, there seem to be <style="highlight">fewer people in the plaza</style> than at the beginning.

say:23:1610318022:1.text: Really? Now that you mention it... Yeah, there are fewer people.
say:23:1610318022:1.source_cn: 咦？你这么一说……一、二、三……好像是哦……

say:24:1610318023:1.text: Maybe they chose to give up after seeing Cassadee and Gervan here... I'd do the same if I were in their shoes.
say:24:1610318023:1.source_cn: 是不是看到科丝蒂和格墨文都在，选择放弃了……要、要不然...

say:25:1610318024:1.text:
... No, no, no!
I can't think like this. I can't let Professor Solise down!
say:25:1610318024:1.source_cn: ……不行不行不行！\n我不能辜负娑丽丝老师的期待！

say:26:1610318025:1.text: This isn't just a selection. I smell a mystery brewing...
say:26:1610318025:1.source_cn: 这不是简单的选拔赛，说不定有什么玄机。

say:27:1610318026:1.text: It's no fun just waiting here. Let's go have a look around.
say:27:1610318026:1.source_cn: 干等着也没意思，我们四处去看看吧。

choice:6:0:1.text: Why did you leave the Astral Academy?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 为什么不在星界学院继续学习？
choice:6:0:1.male: Why did you leave the Astral Academy?
choice:6:0:1.female: Why did you leave the Astral Academy?

say:29:1610318008:0.text: I'm a special admission student. Actually... I was expelled from my previous school.
say:29:1610318008:0.source_cn: 我算是特招生。其实……我被原来的学校开除了。
say:29:1610318008:0.male: I'm a special admission student. Actually... I was expelled from my previous school.
say:29:1610318008:0.female: I'm a special admission student. Actually... I was expelled from my previous school.

say:30:1610318009:0.text: It was Professor Solise who recommended me for the special admissions program, allowing me to continue my studies at the Lyceum.
say:30:1610318009:0.source_cn: 是娑丽丝老师给我了特招名额，让我在莱希拉姆继续学习。
say:30:1610318009:0.male: It was Professor Solise who recommended me for the special admissions program, allowing me to continue my studies at the Lyceum.
say:30:1610318009:0.female: It was Professor Solise who recommended me for the special admissions program, allowing me to continue my studies at the Lyceum.

choice:6:1:2.text: Are you also a transfer student?
choice:6:1:2.male: Are you also a transfer student?
choice:6:1:2.female: Are you also a transfer student?

choice:2:0:1.text: You seem to be used to this.
choice:2:0:1.male: You seem to be used to this.
choice:2:0:1.female: You seem to be used to this.

say:31:1610318003:1.text: Yeah, whatever type of magic she tries, it becomes volatile in her hands.
say:31:1610318003:1.source_cn: 被你看出来了。不管是什么魔法，在她手里都会变得很暴躁。
say:31:1610318003:1.male: Yeah, whatever type of magic she tries, it becomes volatile in her hands.
say:31:1610318003:1.female: Yeah, whatever type of magic she tries, it becomes volatile in her hands.

say:0:1610319001:0.text: I'll go look around as well.
say:0:1610319001:0.male: I'll go look around as well.
say:0:1610319001:0.female: I'll go look around as well.

say:0:1610321001:0.text: Pippa is chatting with an animal, but I can't understand a word. Maybe I'll transform into one to listen in.
say:0:1610321001:0.source_cn: 皮帕在和动物聊天，听不懂……用变形术变成动物再听听看。
say:0:1610321001:0.male: Pippa is chatting with an animal, but I can't understand a word. Maybe I'll transform into one to listen in.
say:0:1610321001:0.female: Pippa is chatting with an animal, but I can't understand a word. Maybe I'll transform into one to listen in.

say:0:1610321501:0.text: Are you crazy? What are you doing?

say:2:1610322001:2.source_cn: 啊啊啊对不起对不起对不起——！！！

say:3:1610322002:2.text: You see Pippa on her knees, flustered and at a complete loss, before a parrot that is flapping its wings, its tail feathers emitting faint wisps of smoke.
say:3:1610322002:2.source_cn: 你看见皮帕正手足无措地跪在一只鹦鹉面前，鹦鹉扑腾着翅膀...
say:3:1610322002:2.male: You see Pippa on her knees, flustered and at a complete loss, before a parrot that is flapping its wings, its tail feathers emitting faint wisps of smoke.
say:3:1610322002:2.female: You see Pippa on her knees, flustered and at a complete loss, before a parrot that is flapping its wings, its tail feathers emitting faint wisps of smoke.

say:4:1610322003:1.text: She lit him up... Burned this year's champion... Feather Race Champion.
say:4:1610322003:1.source_cn: 她点燃了它！她点燃了它！那是今年的羽毛比赛冠军！！

say:5:1610322004:1.text: Oh no! Without my beautiful tail feathers, how can I ever court a mate?
say:5:1610322004:1.source_cn: 没了漂亮的尾羽，我再也不能求偶了！

say:6:1610322005:1.text:
Please don't be angry! I have a spell to regenerate feathers.
Although last time I tried it, mushrooms appeared instead of feathers... I'm sure it will work this time!
say:6:1610322005:1.source_cn: 别生气，我可以用羽毛再生术。\n呃……虽然上次用的时候...

say:8:1610322006:3.text: You stop Pippa and help the parrot repair his burnt tail feathers.
say:8:1610322006:3.source_cn: 你阻止了皮帕，并帮助鹦鹉修复了烧焦的尾羽。
say:8:1610322006:3.male: You stop Pippa and help the parrot repair his burnt tail feathers.
say:8:1610322006:3.female: You stop Pippa and help the parrot repair his burnt tail feathers.

say:10:1610322007:0.text: My feathers! They're okay! Thank you so much!
say:10:1610322007:0.source_cn: 我的羽毛！太好了……谢谢你魔法师！
say:10:1610322007:0.male: My feathers! They're okay! Thank you so much!
say:10:1610322007:0.female: My feathers! They're okay! Thank you so much!

say:11:1610322008:1.text: Thank you for helping, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. This parrot broke some of his feathers in a panic, so I wanted to treat him, but it didn't go well.
say:11:1610322008:1.male: Thank you for helping, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. This parrot broke some of his feathers in a panic, so I wanted to treat him, but it didn't go well.
say:11:1610322008:1.female: Thank you for helping, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. This parrot broke some of his feathers in a panic, so I wanted to treat him, but it didn't go well.

say:12:1610322009:1.text: Actually, I just wanted to ask these animals if they had seen anything unusual...
say:12:1610322009:1.source_cn: 其实我本来只是想问问它们有没有看到什么不寻常的现象……
say:12:1610322009:1.male: Actually, I just wanted to ask these animals if they had seen anything unusual...
say:12:1610322009:1.female: Actually, I just wanted to ask these animals if they had seen anything unusual...

say:14:1610322010:1.text: Unusual? Those students... in the light... vanished... in a flash.
say:14:1610322010:1.source_cn: 不寻常，那些学生，在光里，咻地一下就不见了。

say:15:1610322011:1.text: In the light? Vanished in a flash?

say:16:1610322012:1.text: Yes, I saw it... where the round pattern... was on the ground.
say:16:1610322012:1.source_cn: 是的，我看见了，就在地上有圆圆图案的地方。

say:17:1610322013:1.text: He's talking about the plaza near Solstice Hall. I'll go and take a look.
say:17:1610322013:1.source_cn: 说的好像是日时礼堂的广场……我也去看看。
say:17:1610322013:1.male: He's talking about the plaza near Solstice Hall. I'll go and take a look.
say:17:1610322013:1.female: He's talking about the plaza near Solstice Hall. I'll go and take a look.

say:0:1610323001:0.text: Let's look around the sundial again.
say:0:1610323001:0.source_cn: 去日时仪附近再看看吧。
say:0:1610323001:0.male: Let's look around the sundial again.
say:0:1610323001:0.female: Let's look around the sundial again.

say:0:1610323501:0.text: A student just disappeared at the sundial!
say:0:1610323501:0.source_cn: 刚才日时仪上有个学生不见了！

say:2:1610323503:0.text: Yes, there was a flash of light!
say:2:1610323503:0.source_cn: 真的！光芒一闪，人就不见了！

say:1:1610324001:1.text: So you're saying that someone stood on the center of the sundial, a strong flash of light went off, and then the person was just... gone?
say:1:1610324001:1.source_cn: 有人站在日时仪里面，强光一闪，人就没了？

say:3:1610324003:1.text: Cassadee, Gervan, what do you think?
say:3:1610324003:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂，格墨文，你们怎么看？

say:5:1610324004:1.source_cn: 嗯……听上去像是传送魔法。

say:6:1610324005:1.text: I was standing there just now, and nothing happened. It seems it needs a trigger of some sort for the magic to work.
say:6:1610324005:1.source_cn: 我刚才也站在那里，什么事都发生，看来需要借助媒介启动传...

say:7:1610324006:1.text: Perhaps... this is also part of the exam. This selection might've already begun.
say:7:1610324006:1.source_cn: 也许……这就是考试的内容。这场选拔，说不定已经开始了。

say:8:1610324007:1.text: Okay, let's take a closer look at that sundial.
say:8:1610324007:1.source_cn: 好，那我们再去仔细观察一下日时仪吧。

say:0:1610325001:0.text: We need to get super close to the sundial to check it out.
say:0:1610325001:0.source_cn: 再仔细观察观察日时仪。

say:1:1610327001:1.text: You stand by the ancient sundial's pointer, listening to the whisper of time. Cassadee approaches, and you discuss your findings together.
say:1:1610327001:1.source_cn: 你在那座古老日时仪的指针旁伫立良久，仿佛聆听到时间的低...
say:1:1610327001:1.male: You stand by the ancient sundial's pointer, listening to the whisper of time. Cassadee approaches, and you discuss your findings together.
say:1:1610327001:1.female: You stand by the ancient sundial's pointer, listening to the whisper of time. Cassadee approaches, and you discuss your findings together.

say:3:1610327002:1.text: The hands of this sundial are very strange.
say:3:1610327002:1.source_cn: 这座日时仪的指针好奇怪。

say:4:1610327003:1.text: I've been standing here for fifteen minutes. For the first ten, the hand didn't move at all, but in the last five, it moved two notches.
say:4:1610327003:1.source_cn: 我在这里站了十五分钟。前十分钟，指针一动不动，但刚刚的...

say:5:1610327004:1.text: In other words, the movement of the pointer is not based on the passage of time.
say:5:1610327004:1.source_cn: 也就是说，指针的移动，不以时间的流逝为标准。

say:6:1610327005:1.text: Then what is it based on...?

say:8:1610327006:1.text: Just then, another student walks into the center of the sundial.
say:8:1610327006:1.source_cn: 此时，又有一名学生走入了日时仪中央。
say:8:1610327006:1.male: Just then, another student walks into the center of the sundial.
say:8:1610327006:1.female: Just then, another student walks into the center of the sundial.

document:0:396:0.text:
An ancient saying is engraved around the small hole at the center of the sundial.

say:0:1610340001:0.female: Since there's no class now, let's quickly make the key.

document:0:397:0.text:
Engrave a reactive force field spell rune onto the <style="highlight">bluefire steel</style>.
Cut a <style="highlight">goldprism crystal</style> from its ore and embed it at the center of the rune.
To make two keys, we need <style="highlight">two</style> pieces of bluefire steel and goldprism crystals, forged together in a single batch.
document:0:397:0.source_cn:
在<style="highlight">蓝火钢</style>上雕刻反作用力场魔法术式符文。
从原石上切割出一份<style="highlight">金色棱光石晶体</style>，镶嵌至符文中心。
一块蓝火钢和一份金色棱光石晶体可以制成一把钥匙，我们需要两把钥匙，因此需使用<style="highlight">双份材料</style>，一次制作完成。

document:0:397:0.female:

say:1:1610342001:1.text: According to Professor Winston, this key should be able to activate the mechanism in the sundial.
say:1:1610342001:1.source_cn: 按照温斯顿先生的说法，这种钥匙应该就可以激活日时仪中的...
say:1:1610342001:1.male: According to Professor Winston, this key should be able to activate the mechanism in the sundial.
say:1:1610342001:1.female: According to Professor Winston, this key should be able to activate the mechanism in the sundial.

say:2:1610342002:1.text: Time is of the essence. Let's head back.
say:2:1610342002:1.source_cn: 时间紧急，我们赶紧回去试试！
say:2:1610342002:1.male: Time is of the essence. Let's head back.
say:2:1610342002:1.female: Time is of the essence. Let's head back.

say:4:1610342003:1.text: With the help of Cassadee, you successfully obtain the key to activate the sundial.

say:4:1610342003:1.female: With the help of Cassadee, you successfully obtain the key to activate the sundial.

say:1:1610344001:1.text: Well, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I just took another look at the small hole on the sundial.

say:2:1610344002:1.text: It feels a bit familiar... Where have I seen this shape before?
say:2:1610344002:1.source_cn: 总觉得有点眼熟……奇怪，我在哪里见过这个形状呢？
say:2:1610344002:1.male: It feels a bit familiar... Where have I seen this shape before?
say:2:1610344002:1.female: It feels a bit familiar... Where have I seen this shape before?

say:3:1610344003:1.text: I have to remember! I can't disappoint Professor Solise!
say:3:1610344003:1.source_cn: 不行，我要回忆起来啊！我、我不能辜负娑丽丝老师的期待！
say:3:1610344003:1.male: I have to remember! I can't disappoint Professor Solise!
say:3:1610344003:1.female: I have to remember! I can't disappoint Professor Solise!

choice_prompt:4:1610344003.source_cn: 不行，我要回忆起来啊！我、我不能辜负娑丽丝老师的期待！
choice_prompt:4:1610344003.male: I have to remember! I can't disappoint Professor Solise!
choice_prompt:4:1610344003.female: I have to remember! I can't disappoint Professor Solise!

say:5:1610344004:1.text: It's really hard to think... My mind is blank...
say:5:1610344004:1.source_cn: 嗯……我已经很努力地在想了……可脑子里一片空白。
say:5:1610344004:1.male: It's really hard to think... My mind is blank...
say:5:1610344004:1.female: It's really hard to think... My mind is blank...

say:6:1610344005:1.text: Ugh, my brain's on the fritz! That dip in the lake must've short-circuited everything! My head's all foggy...
say:6:1610344005:1.source_cn: 肯定因为我刚才掉进了湖里，吓得我脑袋沉甸甸的，什么都想...
say:6:1610344005:1.male: Ugh, my brain's on the fritz! That dip in the lake must've short-circuited everything! My head's all foggy...
say:6:1610344005:1.female: Ugh, my brain's on the fritz! That dip in the lake must've short-circuited everything! My head's all foggy...

say:7:1610344007:1.text: Oh wait... I remember... the lake... water... underwater... fish...
say:7:1610344007:1.source_cn: 等等，水……湖水……我掉进湖里……水下……鱼……
say:7:1610344007:1.male: Oh wait... I remember... the lake... water... underwater... fish...
say:7:1610344007:1.female: Oh wait... I remember... the lake... water... underwater... fish...

say:8:1610344008:1.text: Yes! When I was flailing underwater, I saw something! Those things nudging me didn't feel like fish... They felt like... tiny wind-up toys... like keys!
say:8:1610344008:1.source_cn: 啊！我掉进湖里的时候，有一群奇怪的鱼不停撞我，我那时候...
say:8:1610344008:1.male: Yes! When I was flailing underwater, I saw something! Those things nudging me didn't feel like fish... They felt like... tiny wind-up toys... like keys!
say:8:1610344008:1.female: Yes! When I was flailing underwater, I saw something! Those things nudging me didn't feel like fish... They felt like... tiny wind-up toys... like keys!

say:9:1610344009:1.text: I think one of them swam into my pocket!
say:9:1610344009:1.source_cn: 被你们救上来以后，我整个人都是懵懵的，顺手就把那个东西...
say:9:1610344009:1.male: I think one of them swam into my pocket!
say:9:1610344009:1.female: I think one of them swam into my pocket!

choice_prompt:10:1610344009.text: I think one of them swam into my pocket!
choice_prompt:10:1610344009.source_cn: 被你们救上来以后，我整个人都是懵懵的，顺手就把那个东西放在口袋里。
choice_prompt:10:1610344009.male: I think one of them swam into my pocket!
choice_prompt:10:1610344009.female: I think one of them swam into my pocket!

say:11:1610344010:2.text: Hey, look at this! This couldn't be the key we need, could it?
say:11:1610344010:2.source_cn: 你看，就是这个。欸，这……这不会就是启动机关的钥匙吧！
say:11:1610344010:2.male: Hey, look at this! This couldn't be the key we need, could it?
say:11:1610344010:2.female: Hey, look at this! This couldn't be the key we need, could it?

say:13:1610344012:2.text: I can try to find another.
say:13:1610344012:2.source_cn: 我可以再想办法找一把。
say:13:1610344012:2.male: I can try to find another.
say:13:1610344012:2.female: I can try to find another.

choice_prompt:14:1610344012.text: I can try to find another.
choice_prompt:14:1610344012.source_cn: 我可以再想办法找一把。
choice_prompt:14:1610344012.male: I can try to find another.
choice_prompt:14:1610344012.female: I can try to find another.

say:15:1610344013:1.text: Of course, you all saved me earlier, so now it's my turn to help you. I'll take you to find that strange fish key!
say:15:1610344013:1.source_cn: 好，你们救了我，这次轮到我帮你们了，我带你去找那种鱼！
say:15:1610344013:1.male: Of course, you all saved me earlier, so now it's my turn to help you. I'll take you to find that strange fish key!
say:15:1610344013:1.female: Of course, you all saved me earlier, so now it's my turn to help you. I'll take you to find that strange fish key!

choice:14:0:1.text: Let's find the second one together.
choice:14:0:1.male: Let's find the second one together.
choice:14:0:1.female: Let's find the second one together.

choice:4:0:1.text: Just try to recall it carefully.
choice:4:0:1.male: Just try to recall it carefully.
choice:4:0:1.female: Just try to recall it carefully.

say:17:1610344006:1.text: No water for me! I inhaled half the lake when I fell in. I'm practically a walking aquarium now.
say:17:1610344006:1.source_cn: 不、不喝了……刚才掉进湖里的时候，我吓得呛了好多好多水...
say:17:1610344006:1.male: No water for me! I inhaled half the lake when I fell in. I'm practically a walking aquarium now.
say:17:1610344006:1.female: No water for me! I inhaled half the lake when I fell in. I'm practically a walking aquarium now.

choice:4:1:2.text: Drink some water and calm down.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 先别想了，喝口水冷静一下
choice:4:1:2.male: Drink some water and calm down.
choice:4:1:2.female: Drink some water and calm down.

say:0:1610345001:0.text: Try to see if you can catch any here.
say:0:1610345001:0.source_cn: 试试在这里能不能钓到。
say:0:1610345001:0.male: Try to see if you can catch any here.
say:0:1610345001:0.female: Try to see if you can catch any here.

say:0:1610346001:0.text: Maybe those birds know where the fish we're looking for are. Let me transform and ask.
say:0:1610346001:0.source_cn: 也许那些小鸟知道在哪片水域见过这种鱼，变成狼问问它们好了……
say:0:1610346001:0.male: Maybe those birds know where the fish we're looking for are. Let me transform and ask.
say:0:1610346001:0.female: Maybe those birds know where the fish we're looking for are. Let me transform and ask.

say:0:1610347001:0.text: It's time to talk to a bird.
say:0:1610347001:0.male: It's time to talk to a bird.
say:0:1610347001:0.female: It's time to talk to a bird.

say:2:1610348001:1.text: Hello, excuse me, have you ever seen this thing before?
say:2:1610348001:1.source_cn: 女士，请问，你有没有见过这个？

say:3:1610348002:1.text: They're found in the water. If you've seen them, please tell us.
say:3:1610348002:1.source_cn: 它们在水里出没，如果你见过，请一定要告诉我们。

say:4:1610348003:1.text: Oh, the shiny little things that swim with the wind? Yes, yes! Disgusting taste. Wouldn't recommend.
say:4:1610348003:1.source_cn: 啾啾！是那些可以把风当水游，并且一点也不好吃的家伙！

choice_prompt:5:1610348003.text: Oh, the shiny little things that swim with the wind? Yes, yes! Disgusting taste. Wouldn't recommend.
choice_prompt:5:1610348003.source_cn: 啾啾！是那些可以把风当水游，并且一点也不好吃的家伙！

say:9:1610348005:1.text: Hmm... let's not rush into details. First, take a moment to appreciate me. How magnificent are my wings today?
say:9:1610348005:1.source_cn: 先别说这个啾，先夸夸啾刚刚打理好的羽毛漂亮不漂亮！
say:9:1610348005:1.male: Hmm... let's not rush into details. First, take a moment to appreciate me. How magnificent are my wings today?
say:9:1610348005:1.female: Hmm... let's not rush into details. First, take a moment to appreciate me. How magnificent are my wings today?

say:10:1610348006:1.text: Umm... They look so pretty! So sleek and glossy!
say:10:1610348006:1.source_cn: 呃……特别好看！像打了蜡一样光滑呢。

say:13:1610348008:1.text: Uh... They're more beautiful than the rainbow in the sky!
say:13:1610348008:1.source_cn: 比……比天上的彩虹还好看！

say:16:1610348010:1.text: Angry featherless things... Ah! Don't tug on my feathers! I'll tell you!
say:16:1610348010:1.source_cn: 啾、啾啾……是脾气暴躁的人类……不要打啾！啾说……
say:16:1610348010:1.male: Angry featherless things... Ah! Don't tug on my feathers! I'll tell you!
say:16:1610348010:1.female: Angry featherless things... Ah! Don't tug on my feathers! I'll tell you!

say:17:1610348013:1.text: I've seen them on the side of the island with the most water plants!
say:17:1610348013:1.source_cn: 啾在这座岛屿水草最丰美的那一边见过！
say:17:1610348013:1.male: I've seen them on the side of the island with the most water plants!
say:17:1610348013:1.female: I've seen them on the side of the island with the most water plants!

say:18:1610348014:1.text: Aquatic plants! Got it! So it's back to the scene of the crime... I mean, my earlier impromptu swim.
say:18:1610348014:1.source_cn: 水草丰美……唔，我落水的地方水草倒是很丰美。看来还是得...

say:19:1610348015:1.text: Thanks for your help, you dazzling feathered diva.
say:19:1610348015:1.source_cn: 啾啾女士，谢谢你的帮助！

say:22:1610348011:1.text: NO! Wait! Do not abandon me! Okay, okay, I'll tell you.
say:22:1610348011:1.source_cn: 别走！啾告诉你们就是了……
say:22:1610348011:1.male: NO! Wait! Do not abandon me! Okay, okay, I'll tell you.
say:22:1610348011:1.female: NO! Wait! Do not abandon me! Okay, okay, I'll tell you.

choice:15:1:2.text: Pippa, let's go ask the other birds.
choice:15:1:2.male: Pippa, let's go ask the other birds.
choice:15:1:2.female: Pippa, let's go ask the other birds.

say:23:1610348012:1.text: *Gasp*... You truly understand art. Fine, I'll tell you.
say:23:1610348012:1.source_cn: 啾啾啾！啾很满意！啾告诉你们！
say:23:1610348012:1.male: *Gasp*... You truly understand art. Fine, I'll tell you.
say:23:1610348012:1.female: *Gasp*... You truly understand art. Fine, I'll tell you.

choice:15:2:3.text: If beauty had wings, it would be you.
choice:15:2:3.male: If beauty had wings, it would be you.
choice:15:2:3.female: If beauty had wings, it would be you.

narration:1:1610350501:0.source_cn: 皮帕将钥匙放入日时仪，一阵光芒闪过，她从广场中消失了

say:2:1610352001:0.text: Hey, we're planning to go check out the island to the east.
say:2:1610352001:0.source_cn: 哟，我们正打算去东南方的小岛看看。
say:2:1610352001:0.male: Hey, we're planning to go check out the island to the east.
say:2:1610352001:0.female: Hey, we're planning to go check out the island to the east.

choice_prompt:4:1610352001.text: Hey, we're planning to go check out the island to the east.
choice_prompt:4:1610352001.source_cn: 哟，我们正打算去东南方的小岛看看。
choice_prompt:4:1610352001.male: Hey, we're planning to go check out the island to the east.
choice_prompt:4:1610352001.female: Hey, we're planning to go check out the island to the east.

say:5:1610352002:1.text: I heard that a lot of golems are attacking people there. Many people were hurt.
say:5:1610352002:1.source_cn: 听说那边有好多会攻击人的魔偶，有好多人遭了殃。
say:5:1610352002:1.male: I heard that a lot of golems are attacking people there. Many people were hurt.
say:5:1610352002:1.female: I heard that a lot of golems are attacking people there. Many people were hurt.

say:6:1610352003:1.text: Nothing that hazardous appears by accident. Their presence implies deliberate action and a conscious effort to place them there.
say:6:1610352003:1.source_cn: 这么危险的东西不可能突然出现在岛上，一定是人为运送来的。
say:6:1610352003:1.male: Nothing that hazardous appears by accident. Their presence implies deliberate action and a conscious effort to place them there.
say:6:1610352003:1.female: Nothing that hazardous appears by accident. Their presence implies deliberate action and a conscious effort to place them there.

say:7:1610352004:1.text: This must be a test specifically designed for us.
say:7:1610352004:1.source_cn: 这是为我们特地设下的考题。
say:7:1610352004:1.male: This must be a test specifically designed for us.
say:7:1610352004:1.female: This must be a test specifically designed for us.

say:10:1610352006:1.text: I thought you'd definitely team up with Cassadee, but choosing us was a smart move. Now our chances of success are even higher.
say:10:1610352006:1.source_cn: 还以为你肯定会和科丝蒂一起行动呢，总之，选我们是明智的...
say:10:1610352006:1.male: I thought you'd definitely team up with Cassadee, but choosing us was a smart move. Now our chances of success are even higher.
say:10:1610352006:1.female: I thought you'd definitely team up with Cassadee, but choosing us was a smart move. Now our chances of success are even higher.

say:11:1610352007:1.text: The hands on the sundial are almost at two o'clock. We have to hurry.
say:11:1610352007:1.source_cn: 日时仪的指针又往前走了两格，剩下的名额恐怕不多了，我们...
say:11:1610352007:1.male: The hands on the sundial are almost at two o'clock. We have to hurry.
say:11:1610352007:1.female: The hands on the sundial are almost at two o'clock. We have to hurry.

say:0:1610354001:0.text: There was a strong magical aura emanating from that stone door, but the mechanism to open it is on the opposite island.
say:0:1610354001:0.source_cn: 那座石门里有很强的魔法感应，但打开它的机关在对面的岛上。

say:0:1610354501:0.text: Let's sneak to the shore first. It's best not to alarm those creatures.
say:0:1610354501:0.source_cn: 我们先潜行到岸边，最好别惊动那些怪物。
say:0:1610354501:0.male: Let's sneak to the shore first. It's best not to alarm those creatures.
say:0:1610354501:0.female: Let's sneak to the shore first. It's best not to alarm those creatures.

say:2:1610355001:1.text: You look around. There are no boats in sight. You can't cross by water, but the distance isn't far. If you turn into a wolf, you might be able to leap across.
say:2:1610355001:1.source_cn: 你环顾四周，岸边没有船只，你们无法乘船渡湖，但这段距离...
say:2:1610355001:1.male: You look around. There are no boats in sight. You can't cross by water, but the distance isn't far. If you turn into a wolf, you might be able to leap across.
say:2:1610355001:1.female: You look around. There are no boats in sight. You can't cross by water, but the distance isn't far. If you turn into a wolf, you might be able to leap across.

say:3:1610355002:1.text: There is no boat here. We have to think of a way to get across... Oh, maybe you can use transfiguration.
say:3:1610355002:1.source_cn: 这里没有船，我们得想想办法了……对了，也许可以用变形术？

say:4:1610355003:1.text: But what about you? I mean... you know...

say:5:1610355004:1.text: It's okay. You two go on ahead. I'll find another way.
say:5:1610355004:1.source_cn: 没关系，你们先走，我去另寻他路。

say:8:1610355006:1.text: No, it's fine, Silven. You can work with our new friend here.
say:8:1610355006:1.source_cn: 不，休，你与新同学一起行动，不用担心我。
say:8:1610355006:1.male: No, it's fine, Silven. You can work with our new friend here.
say:8:1610355006:1.female: No, it's fine, Silven. You can work with our new friend here.

say:0:1610356001:0.text: The distance is a bit too far. I have to turn into a wolf to jump over.
say:0:1610356001:0.source_cn: 距离太远了，得变成狼才能跳过去。
say:0:1610356001:0.male: The distance is a bit too far. I have to turn into a wolf to jump over.
say:0:1610356001:0.female: The distance is a bit too far. I have to turn into a wolf to jump over.

say:0:1610357001:0.text: Contess was telling the truth. The transfiguration spell is very useful.
say:0:1610357001:0.source_cn: 康缇丝这个恶魔居然没骗人，变形术还真的挺好用的。
say:0:1610357001:0.male: Contess was telling the truth. The transfiguration spell is very useful.
say:0:1610357001:0.female: Contess was telling the truth. The transfiguration spell is very useful.

say:0:1610358001:0.text: Be careful. Stay hidden, and don't alert them.
say:0:1610358001:0.source_cn: 小心，继续潜行，不要惊动它们。
say:0:1610358001:0.male: Be careful. Stay hidden, and don't alert them.
say:0:1610358001:0.female: Be careful. Stay hidden, and don't alert them.

say:0:1610360001:0.text: This mechanism should be what opens the stone door.
say:0:1610360001:0.source_cn: 这个机关应该就是用来打开石门的。
say:0:1610360001:0.male: This mechanism should be what opens the stone door.
say:0:1610360001:0.female: This mechanism should be what opens the stone door.

say:0:1610362001:0.text: Let's go back and check if the door is open.
say:0:1610362001:0.male: Let's go back and check if the door is open.
say:0:1610362001:0.female: Let's go back and check if the door is open.

say:0:1610363001:0.text: It's open! The key for the sundial should be here.
say:0:1610363001:0.source_cn: 打开了！启动日时仪机关的钥匙应该就在这里。
say:0:1610363001:0.male: It's open! The key for the sundial should be here.
say:0:1610363001:0.female: It's open! The key for the sundial should be here.

say:1:1610363002:0.text: I took a bit of a detour. Am I late?

say:2:1610365001:1.text: I was worried about you, Gervan... I didn't expect you to catch up so quickly.

say:1:1610368001:1.text: To the students of the Serene Lyceum, I am honored to visit your distinguished school, celebrated throughout Esperia, to oversee the appointment of the new court mage.

say:3:1610368003:1.text: Let the finest among you prove their worth. Bring your wisdom, your unwavering resolve, and your ambition. I await our reunion within the halls of Savannah's palace.

say:5:1610368005:1.text: Your potential is boundless. You may walk the path of legends, as Merlin himself once did, and inscribe your name for all eternity upon the sacred annals of Esperia.

say:6:1610368006:1.text: Let this be the legacy all here strive for.
say:6:1610368006:1.source_cn: 这就是我对你们的期望。

say:7:1610368007:1.source_cn: 我宣布，宫廷魔法师选拔正式开始！
